name: Threat From the Sea
summary: Tok'Kar works on your weapon while Katar reports the beach patrols could use help.

sections.title: A Word with Katar
sections.body: Tok'Kar works on your weapon and sends you to Katar. Katar says the beach patrols could use help. Some louses at camp drink, but Tok'Kar would rather you keep your wits sharp and your weapons ready than join them.

sections.title: Over the Roar of the Sea
sections.body: Katar asks you for a moment of silence. Over the sea's dull roar, you can hear the fish men's disgusting gurgling.

faq.q: Why does Tok'Kar send you to Katar?
faq.answer: Tok'Kar is busy with your weapon, so he sends you to Katar and wants you to keep your wits and weapons ready instead of drinking with the louses at camp.

faq.q: What does Katar need assistance with?
faq.answer: Katar says the patrols along the beach could use some help.
After Lack of Surplus, Tok'Kar begins work on your weapon.
